name: MonarchCallStage
title: CallStage
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout (Column, Row, BoxWithConstraints, horizontalScroll) composing MonarchCallTile, MonarchCalloutBanner, MonarchBadge, MonarchButton and androidx.compose.material3.IconButton
summary: The call itself: a header with the title, a running timer and the head count, everyone's call tiles in a grid or a spotlight with a filmstrip, connection notices and the controls.
whenToUse: For the main screen of a video or audio call, or a docked or picture in picture view of it, fed by the app's call SDK.
whenNotToUse: For one participant's tile use MonarchCallTile; for a minimized call use the mini-call pattern; for the controls alone use MonarchCallControls.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchCallStage(participants: List<MonarchCallStageParticipant>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, startedAt: Long? = null, now: Long? = null, mode: MonarchCallControlsLayout = MonarchCallControlsLayout.Automatic, pinnedId: String? = null, onPinnedIdChange: ((String?) -> Unit)? = null, activeSpeakerId: String? = null, layout: MonarchCallStageLayout? = null, surface: MonarchCallStageSurface = MonarchCallStageSurface.Stage, lowData: Boolean = false, reconnecting: Boolean = false, error: String? = null, speakingWhileMuted: Boolean = false, icons: MonarchCallStageIcons = MonarchCallStageIcons(), labels: MonarchCallStageLabels = MonarchCallStageLabels(), onSurfaceChange: ((MonarchCallStageSurface) -> Unit)? = null, onMinimize: (() -> Unit)? = null, onPictureInPicture: (() -> Unit)? = null, onFullScreen: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, video: (@Composable (MonarchCallStageParticipant) -> Unit)? = null, controls: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)

class MonarchCallStageParticipant(id: String, name: String, image: Painter? = null, showVideo: Boolean = true, self: Boolean = false, micOff: Boolean = false, speaking: Boolean = false, handRaised: Boolean = false, screen: Boolean = false, status: String? = null, statusTone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Neutral, quality: MonarchCallQuality? = null, reaction: MonarchCallReaction? = null)
sealed class MonarchCallStageLayout { class Grid(ids: List<String>, columns: Int); class Spotlight(main: String, strip: List<String>) }

fun MonarchCallStageLayout.Companion.automatic(selfId: String?, ids: List<String>, mode: MonarchCallControlsLayout, pinnedId: String? = null, sharerId: String? = null, activeSpeakerId: String? = null): MonarchCallStageLayout
enum class MonarchCallStageSurface { Stage, Docked, Pip }

class MonarchCallStageIcons(tile: MonarchCallTileIcons = MonarchCallTileIcons(), pictureInPicture: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, shrink: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, expand: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, minimize: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)

class MonarchCallStageLabels(tile: MonarchCallTileLabels = MonarchCallTileLabels(), region: String? = null, duration: String? = null, waiting: String? = null, inCall: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, lowData: String? = null, reconnecting: String? = null, mutedHint: String? = null, pictureInPicture: String? = null, shrink: String? = null, expand: String? = null, minimize: String? = null)

options.name: participants
options.description: Everyone on the call, you included (self), in display order, with what each tile shows.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the stage.

options.name: title
options.description: The heading, such as the meeting name. Without it the stage is named "Call".

options.name: startedAt
options.description: When the call started, in epoch milliseconds: shows a running mm:ss (h:mm:ss after an hour) timer.

options.name: now
options.description: The current time for tests and previews; null uses the clock and ticks every second.

options.name: mode
options.description: The layout chosen in MonarchCallControls: Automatic, Grid or Speaker.

options.name: pinnedId
options.description: The pinned participant, shown large.

options.name: onPinnedIdChange
options.description: Adds Pin buttons to the tiles on the full stage; called with the next pinned id, null to unpin.

options.name: activeSpeakerId
options.description: Who is talking, for speaker mode.

options.name: layout
options.description: Replaces the automatic layout.

options.name: surface
options.description: Stage, Docked or Pip. Compact surfaces have at most two columns and no tile buttons.

options.name: lowData
options.description: Shows the "Low data" badge in the header.

options.name: reconnecting
options.description: Shows the warning "You're offline. Trying to reconnect…".

options.name: error
options.description: A problem in the app's words, shown as a danger callout and announced assertively.

options.name: speakingWhileMuted
options.description: Shows the "You're muted" hint under the tiles.

options.name: icons
options.description: Icons for the header buttons and the tiles; without one a button writes its word.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, including the tiles'.

options.name: onSurfaceChange
options.description: Adds Shrink (sends Docked) on the full stage and Expand (sends Stage) when docked.

options.name: onMinimize
options.description: Adds Minimize when docked.

options.name: onPictureInPicture
options.description: Adds the picture in picture button, except on the Pip surface. The app enters picture in picture itself.

options.name: onFullScreen
options.description: Adds full screen to each tile on the full stage; receives the participant id.

options.name: video
options.description: The participant's video from the app's call SDK; without it every tile shows the avatar.

options.name: controls
options.description: The controls under the tiles, usually MonarchCallControls.

states.name: grid
states.description: Tiles in equal columns: one, two up to four people, then three; at most two on a screen narrower than 480dp or a compact surface.

states.name: spotlight
states.description: A pin, someone else's shared screen, the speaker in speaker mode or the other person in a one-to-one call is large; the others are in a filmstrip below that scrolls sideways, or in a column beside it on a full stage at least 840dp wide.

states.name: waiting
states.description: Alone on the call, the header reads "Waiting for others…" instead of the head count.

states.name: reconnecting
states.description: A warning callout under the header, announced politely.

states.name: error
states.description: A danger callout with the app's message, announced assertively.

states.name: muted while speaking
states.description: A warning callout under the tiles, announced politely.

states.name: docked and pip
states.description: Smaller gaps, at most two columns and no Pin or full screen buttons (filmstrip tiles never have them, as MonarchCallTile's small size); docked shows Expand and Minimize, pip has no picture in picture button.

appearance: The tiles are MonarchCallTile on the inverse surface; the header uses the default text color for the title and the muted text color for the timer and head count, with a warning MonarchBadge; notices are MonarchCalloutBanner in the warning and danger tones. Every color is a theme role, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes are covered.
platformNotes: The web's region becomes a traversal group named "Call" when there is no title (with a title the heading names it, so it is not read twice). Video is a composable slot per participant, such as the call SDK's SurfaceView in an AndroidView, instead of a MediaStream and onVideoElement; the app enters picture in picture itself (Activity.enterPictureInPictureMode), so onPictureInPicture only reports the button. The web's 'mini' surface change is onMinimize, as on iOS. The timer is a Text that ticks every second outside any live region, so TalkBack reads it when focused and never announces each second; now pins the time for tests, as in MonarchCallTile. iOS's pinnedID Binding becomes pinnedId with onPinnedIdChange. The web's muted hint mentions keyboard shortcuts; Android says to turn the microphone on. The grid's narrow-screen cap is a width of 480dp (the web's 30rem). It is experimental because it is a product screen built from Monarch primitives that no Rook app has adopted yet.
accessibility: The stage is a traversal group; without a title it is named "Call" (or labels.region).
The timer is one element read as "Call duration, 04:12"; it is not a live region.
The head count ("3 in call" or "Waiting for others…") is a polite live region, so a change is announced once.
The reconnecting notice and the muted hint are polite live regions; the error is assertive.
Header buttons are MonarchButton or Material 3 IconButton with a label and a 48dp touch target.
Each tile is MonarchCallTile: one element per person named by their name with speaking, muted, hand raised, screen, status and quality as its state, and Pin and full screen as separate buttons.
edgeCases: A pinned or spotlighted id that is not among the participants is ignored and the grid is shown.
Your own shared screen never takes the spotlight; the speaker is never yourself.
Ids in a given layout without a participant draw nothing.
Many participants make the stage tall; it does not scroll itself, so put it in a scrolling container or give it a height.
Long titles and names wrap; at the largest font sizes tiles grow taller than 16 by 9.
Announcements and the timer were checked with Robolectric semantics tests, not with TalkBack on a device; the layout choice, columns, buttons, head count and duration are unit-tested.

examples.title: Group call with pin, layout and docking
examples.webExample: Group call with pin, layout and docking
examples.template:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchCallStage(
    participants = listOf(
        MonarchCallStageParticipant({{participants.0.id}}, {{participants.0.name}}, self = {{participants.0.self}}, micOff = !micOn),
        MonarchCallStageParticipant({{participants.1.id}}, {{participants.1.name}}, speaking = {{participants.1.speaking}}, quality = MonarchCallQuality.{{participants.1.quality|pascal}}),
        MonarchCallStageParticipant({{participants.2.id}}, {{participants.2.name}}, micOff = {{participants.2.micOff}}, quality = MonarchCallQuality.{{participants.2.quality|pascal}}),
        MonarchCallStageParticipant({{participants.3.id}}, {{participants.3.name}}, handRaised = {{participants.3.handRaised}}, quality = MonarchCallQuality.{{participants.3.quality|pascal}}),
    ),
    title = {{title}},
    startedAt = 0L,
    now = {{elapsedSeconds}} * 1_000L,
    mode = mode,
    pinnedId = pinned,
    activeSpeakerId = {{activeSpeakerId}},
    surface = surface,
    onSurfaceChange = { surface = it },
    icons = MonarchCallStageIcons(
        shrink = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Shrink, contentDescription = null) },
        tile = MonarchCallTileIcons(
            micOff = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.MicOff, contentDescription = null) },
            handRaised = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.RaiseHand, contentDescription = null) },
        ),
    ),
) {
    MonarchCallControls(
        icon = { control, on ->
            val glyph = when (control) {
                MonarchCallControl.Microphone -> if (on) SampleIcons.Mic else SampleIcons.MicOff
                MonarchCallControl.Camera -> if (on) SampleIcons.Video else SampleIcons.VideoOff
                MonarchCallControl.ShareScreen -> SampleIcons.ScreenShare
                MonarchCallControl.RaiseHand -> SampleIcons.RaiseHand
                MonarchCallControl.React -> SampleIcons.React
                MonarchCallControl.More -> SampleIcons.More
                MonarchCallControl.Leave -> SampleIcons.CallEnd
            }
            MonarchIcon(glyph, contentDescription = null)
        },
        micOn = micOn,
        onMicOnChange = { micOn = it },
        layout = mode,
        onLayoutChange = { mode = it },
        minimal = surface != MonarchCallStageSurface.Stage,
        onLeave = {},
    )
}
